title: Clopen restriction identifies the strict quotient and finite pullback towers
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme V, and a clopen open U of V. Use the global completed-integral quotient tower of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], normalized ordinary complex restriction of [def-pur-open-completed-restriction-data], and the actual finite pullback tower of [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower]. Restricting the quotient tower termwise is naturally isomorphic to the strict finite pullback tower along U to V. This is a natural isomorphism on all unbounded complexes, before forming any product or Roos complex and before derived localization; no prime invertibility, completeness, boundedness or constructibility is assumed.

proof.text: Use the proved normalized ordinary restriction/ambient pullback comparison, obtained by transposing the finite and completed coefficient isomorphisms under the site adjunction and applying module adjoint uniqueness.

Use sf_clopen_coefficient_comparison and lift its ring isomorphisms through the fully faithful CommRing-to-Ring sheaf functor. Constant normalization and projection uniqueness identify the lifted datum with OpenCompletedRestriction.coefficients. Thus ordinarySfIso identifies the two existing ordinary restriction presentations.
Use the proved strict scalar quotient tower comparison, whose naturality and transitions are checked on sheafified pure tensors.

Use IntegralOnSlice.globalTower_eq on both schemes and ordinarySfIso termwise to transport the strict quotient comparison to the specified global slice towers. Compose with ordinaryPullIso termwise and the already proved normalized IntegralAmbient.pullTowerModel. This gives the asserted strict pullback tower isomorphism before products, Roos cones or derived localization.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenPullbackQuotientTower
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (U : V.Opens) (hU : IsClosed (U : Set V)) :
    Nonempty (IntegralOnSlice.tower l E V none ⋙
      (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ (IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E V none)
        (IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E U.toScheme none)).obj
          (OpenCompletedRestriction.complexRestriction l E U.ι) ≅
      integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E U.ι)
